xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4958: Agent MCP and bots (W-DOC): Documentation

metadata.sizeJustification: One documentation sweep for the PAN-4927 epic with a single acceptance criterion (AC-30). The finalize lint counts the first two path segments as a subsystem, so every root-level or one-deep doc file (anywhere.mdx, CLAUDE.md, docs.json, configuration/*.mdx, cli/*.mdx, docs/*.md) counts as its own subsystem; the 15 files are 13 small, mostly independent text edits that already run in parallel slots. Splitting into sibling issues would only multiply review overhead for one-paragraph doc changes.

narratives.Problem: Every PAN-4927 work item (PAN-4930..PAN-4957) has merged, and most documented their own surface, but W-DOC's remaining items are open: configuration/bots.mdx and cli/mcp.mdx were never created and are not in docs.json; the bot and connector guide sits inside configuration/mcp.mdx; mcp.mdx's description and intro still call the server a control surface for outside tools; cli/token.mdx is stale (v0.65.0 note, missing scopes, future-tense W-INJ1, no OAuth tokens); harnesses.mdx lacks the D-13 matrix and CP-1/CP-2 labels; DASHBOARD-AUTH.md lacks OAuth lifetimes and the Funnel pointer in /mcp; ROLES.md and CONNECT-SERVICE.md have one inaccurate sentence each; tailscale.mdx, remote-access.mdx and anywhere.mdx never mention Public MCP or bots; pan-4649.md lacks its revision note; CLAUDE.md lacks the MCP invariant; McpSignInsList.tsx has no module header.
narratives.Proposal: Gap-fill per PRD .pan/drafts/pan-4958.md (WI-1..WI-13), which gives the exact text for every insertion. Move the bot guide out of configuration/mcp.mdx into a new configuration/bots.mdx (one commit) and leave a short '## Bots' pointer; create cli/mcp.mdx as the command reference copied from source; list both pages in docs.json next to configuration/mcp and cli/token in the 'Overdeck Anywhere' group; make the remaining one-file fixes. Verify with npm run lint:docs, the root-link checker and, before pan done, npm run lint (AC-30).
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md (already complete)
- No change to CLI help strings or any runtime code; the only source edit is one header comment in McpSignInsList.tsx
- No rewrite of the 19 module headers that already name their child issue; no header on integrations/openclaw/vitest.config.ts
- No re-dating of existing 'next release' rows in anywhere.mdx
- No change to the Connect a bot dialog's Grok Build Tailscale option or the run-mcp.sh @overdeck/core@0.74.0 pin
- No change to configuration/triggers.mdx or any integrations/*/README.md
- No new tests and no pan-mcp skill under sync-sources/skills/
- No duplicate copy of the moved bot guide left in configuration/mcp.mdx
- No concrete @overdeck/core version number written into any doc (keep <version>)

autoDecisions.summary: Move the bot and connector guide from configuration/mcp.mdx into configuration/bots.mdx instead of duplicating or linking it
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD assigns that content to bots.mdx; siblings front-ran it into mcp.mdx; one copy avoids drift and no inbound link targets the moved anchors.

autoDecisions.summary: Place cli/mcp right after cli/token in the 'Overdeck Anywhere' docs.json group
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD says 'next to cli/token'; cli/token lives in 'Overdeck Anywhere', not 'CLI Reference', so the concrete neighbor wins.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a module header only to McpSignInsList.tsx
autoDecisions.rationale: 79 of 81 new source files already name PAN-4927 or their child issue, which traces to the epic; the other header-less file is a vitest config, not a module; a 19-file sweep adds no information.

autoDecisions.summary: New anywhere.mdx rows say 'next release' and existing rows are not re-dated
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the page's own convention; versioning the table is release work, not W-DOC.

autoDecisions.summary: Document Grok Build's Tailscale route as not yet working (#5029)
autoDecisions.rationale: integrations/grok-build/README.md:97-101 says so; docs describe what works, and the dialog mismatch is a code issue.
The quality lint treats each top-level doc file as a subsystem; this is one documentation issue with one acceptance criterion, already split from the epic.
